holes_empty: No holes (golf=hole) loaded here. Draw a line from the tee to the green and choose “Golf Hole”.
holes_help: The holes of the loaded data, by number. Choose a row to select the hole. The length is measured along the line.
lens_description: Golf courses as OSM Carto draws them: tees, fairways and rough in grass green, greens in pitch green, bunkers in sand, water in blue, the holes as thin lines with their number.
lens_hole: Hole (line of play) with number and par
lens_note: Colours after OSM Carto 5.4. Areas are filled at 60 % so the aerial imagery still shows.
rule_course_point_message: {feature} is a point. Draw the course as an area around all its holes.
rule_generic_name_label: Golf feature with a generic name
rule_generic_name_message: {feature} is named “{name}”. The name is for a real name, not for what the feature is.
rule_hole_handicap_label: Golf hole with an invalid handicap
rule_hole_handicap_message: {feature} has the handicap {handicap}; it should be a whole number from 1 to 18.
rule_hole_key_done: Moved the hole number to ref
rule_hole_key_message: {feature} has golf_hole={value}. The hole number belongs in ref.
rule_hole_par_label: Golf hole without a valid par
rule_hole_par_message: {feature} has no par or a par that is not 3 to 6 ({par}).
rule_hole_points_label: Hole with more or fewer points than its par
rule_hole_points_message: {feature} has {points} points; a par {par} has {expected}: the tee, where each shot lands, the green.
rule_hole_shared_message: {feature} shares a node with a golf feature on the ground. The line of play is the ball in the air: disconnect it.
rule_sport_label: sport=golf on a part of the course
rule_sport_message: {feature} has sport=golf. Parts of a course take golf=* only; sport=golf belongs on the course.
rule_water_done: Added natural=water to a water hazard
rule_water_message: {feature} is a water hazard without natural=water, so most maps do not draw it as water.
